sections.title: Delivery Timelines
sections.content: Standard shipping: 5-7 business days. Express: 2-3 business days. International: 10-15 business days. Delivery dates are estimates and not guaranteed. Delays due to carrier or customs are not eligible for automatic compensation.

sections.title: Lost Shipments
sections.content: If tracking shows no update for 7 business days, agent may initiate trace with carrier. If confirmed lost after 14 business days with no delivery, replacement or refund may be issued after verification.

sections.title: Tracking Information
sections.content: Tracking numbers are generated at shipment. Agent must provide correct tracking from order system; must not invent tracking numbers. If order not yet shipped, inform customer with expected ship date.
